evidence.field: 形義通解; 《廣韻》 and Middle Chinese table
evidence.text: The entry analyzes 吧 as 从口、巴声. It lists two 《廣韻》 fanqie entries, 普巴 and 伯加, corresponding to Middle Chinese initials 滂 and 幫 respectively; both are level-tone 麻-rhyme, open division II. It separately lists particle functions and a Qing-novel onomatopoeic example. This supports the component analysis and distinction between the two readings, but does not date the graph’s formation.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 字頭「吧」

evidence.field: UAX #38, §§2.2–2.3, Unihan data and web access
evidence.text: Unicode describes Unihan.zip as a versioned public data snapshot in which each property row records a Unicode scalar value, property name, and value; its interactive lookup may not immediately match the latest data-file release. This supports treating local extract values as versioned reading metadata, not historical sound evidence.
